date_note: The RBI press release is dated 27 November 2026; the page gives no earlier day.
exec: RBI has issued final amendment directions setting a uniform, time-bound procedure for banks to place temporary debit holds on suspected money mule accounts; the directions take effect from 1 July 2027 or an earlier date a bank chooses.
plain: India's central bank issued final rules giving banks a uniform, time-bound procedure to place temporary debit holds on suspected money mule accounts, aimed at cyber-enabled financial fraud. They apply from 1 July 2027 or earlier at a bank's choice.

sources.name: Reserve Bank of India press release

summary: The Reserve Bank of India issued amendment directions on suspected money mule accounts to prevent cyber-enabled financial frauds. According to the RBI press release, they set a uniform, time-bound procedure for banks to place temporary debit holds on amounts or accounts. The directions take effect from 1 July 2027, or an earlier date a bank may decide, and cover commercial, small finance, payments, local area, regional rural and urban co-operative banks.
title: RBI issues amendment directions on suspected money mule accounts to prevent cyber-enabled financial frauds

validation.note: Single source: the RBI's own press release (primary). The six linked notifications were not read.
